A '''Hostility index''' was used by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] to gauge a prisoner's capacity for violence. An Imperial prisoner with a rating of four on this index required two officers to accompany the interrogator. [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gil Bastra]], who died during an interrogation, rated a four on the Imperial Hostility index.
